instruction: Export all my Simple Note notes to "~/backups/simple_note/" directory in my file system. The files should be named according to the note title, replacing white space with "_", and the extension should be ".md".

steps.code:
simple_note_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "simple_note")
login_result = apis.simple_note.login(username="anita.burch@gmail.com", password=simple_note_password)
print(login_result)

access_token = login_result["access_token"]
all_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(all_notes))
print(all_notes)

steps.code:
results = []
for note_meta in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_meta["note_id"], access_token=access_token)
    filename = re.sub(r'\s', '_', note["title"]) + ".md"
    file_path = "~/backups/simple_note/" + filename
    result = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token, content=note["content"], overwrite=True)
    results.append((note["note_id"], file_path, result))
print(len(results))
print(results[:3])

dir_listing = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path="~/backups/simple_note/", entry_type="files", recursive=False)
print(len(dir_listing))
print(dir_listing)
